claims.title: Keep acoustic completion and the two finite-support claims at their separate partial scopes

quoted_fields.interface: The two active-turn snapshots report an exact local acoustic jet map of rank8 with precisely four translation cubics in its kernel, a continuously completed capacity kernel, a supplied-catalogue algebraic17-atom compressor, and a producer-reported16-direction support bound for an optimal completed allocation on an actual field with positive definite covariance. The all-allocation proof and exact compression remain under development; saved failures and the rank3 field demo are separate evidence.
quoted_fields.failure: Ongoing producer-reported work, not a completed all-allocation proof, efficient algorithm, universal-success certificate, independent scientific audit, full-face QC result or established separation. The coordinator assessment is source-based interim judgment, not a replay or completed proof review. Distinguish the supplied-catalogue algebraic <=17 bound from the reported <=16 optimum for actual positive-definite-covariance fields with acoustic limits, which relies on a further global dual-contact argument still being checked. The saved closed-field example has covariance rank3 and does not execute that positive-definite optimum. A certificate universal over admitted polynomials for one field is not universal over gradients. Catalogue failure is not global failure. Closed acoustic atoms encode limiting ROC inequalities, not finite-background Hessian evaluations. Earlier source versions and failed computations remain intact.
